statement: Ironwood TPU three-year committed pricing of $5.40 per hour undercuts B200 on-demand marketplace pricing for customers willing to commit long-term.
why: Hyperscaler accelerators now compete on published price against merchant GPUs, which is how alternative silicon takes share from GPU rentals.

impact.mechanism: Cheaper committed TPU capacity gives large training customers a priced alternative to merchant GPU rental, expanding non-GPU compute supply.

evidence.excerpt: Ironwood's three-year committed rate of $5.40/hr undercuts B200's on-demand pricing for customers willing to commit long-term

confidence.basis: Single secondary blog comparing a list rate against one third-party marketplace quote from a different date.

dispersion: Comparison mixes a September list rate against a July marketplace quote; no GB300 comparison is given.
